title: A New Neighbour
text:
Anna and Pedro are next-door neighbours. Anna is friendly, and she often brings cakes to Pedro's family. Pedro is quieter, but he always helps Anna carry her heavy bags from the car.

One day, Pedro's dog ran into Anna's garden and broke a flower pot. Pedro was embarrassed, so he came to say sorry. Anna laughed and said it was fine, because she trusted him and knew he was a kind person.

questions.text: What does Anna often bring to Pedro's family?
How does Pedro probably feel after his dog breaks the flower pot?
What can the reader infer about the relationship between Anna and Pedro?
options: They are friendly and trust each other
They are strangers who never talk
They do not like living near each other
They are work colleagues in a different city

vocabulary.definition: people who live next to or near you
feeling uncomfortable because of something you did
believed that a person is honest and reliable

paragraph_translations: Anna e Pedro são vizinhos de porta. Anna é simpática e, muitas vezes, leva bolos para a família de Pedro. Pedro é mais calado, mas sempre ajuda Anna a carregar as sacolas pesadas do carro.

Um dia, o cachorro de Pedro entrou no jardim de Anna e quebrou um vaso de flores. Pedro ficou envergonhado, então foi pedir desculpas. Anna riu e disse que estava tudo bem, porque confiava nele e sabia que ele era uma pessoa gentil.
